source.attribution: Huanjian Zhou and Taiji Suzuki, On Complexity of Gaussian Sampling. The selected claim is the final inequality in Ex72. ASTIS makes the actual-law probability and RN integration adapters explicit.
source.scope: Actual averaged Gaussian target TV has the exact exponential lower bound in Ex72. Oracle/query lower bounds and the fixed-spectrum route remain separate.

items.statement: The total variation distance between the actual averaged Gaussian targets has the following explicit lower bound. \operatorname{TV}(\bar\pi_+,\bar\pi_-)\ge1-\exp\!\left[-\frac{\lfloor d/n\rfloor}{8}\exp\!\left(-\frac{10n}{\sqrt\kappa}\right)\right]. \(d,n\in\mathbb N,\ 3\le n\le d,\ \kappa\ge4\); set \(k=\lfloor d/n\rfloor\) and \(r=d-kn=d\bmod n\). Both endpoint inequalities are inclusive. For normalized full orthogonal Haar probability \(\mu_n\), let \(\nu_\pm=2\mu_n|_{\{\det O=\pm1\}}\). Define \(A_O=\frac{\kappa+1}{2}I-\frac{\kappa-1}{4}(O+O^\top)\), \(\mathcal D_\pm=(\boldsymbol O\mapsto\operatorname{diag}(A_{O_1},\ldots,A_{O_k},I_r))_\#\nu_\pm^{\otimes k}\), and the actual averaged targets \(\bar\pi_\pm=\int\mathcal N(0,A^{-1})\,d\mathcal D_\pm(A)\). Each product uses one common sign. Total variation uses the source probability convention \(\delta=\sup_{B\text{ measurable}}|\bar\pi_+(B)-\bar\pi_-(B)|=\frac12\int|f-g|\,dx\). In Lean, each event mass is \(M_\pm.\mathrm{real}(B)=\operatorname{toReal}(M_\pm(B))\); the actual laws are proved to be probabilities internally, so all event masses are finite. Nonempty/bounded event-supremum and mass-one density obligations are discharged by the canonical normalized-density theorem. The proof uses actual ambient RN densities \(f=d\bar\pi_+/dx\), \(g=d\bar\pi_-/dx\), and actual block affinity \(a=\int\sqrt{p_+p_-}\). Absolute continuity, L1, normalization, the exact tensorization \(\int\sqrt{fg}=a^k\), and Eq25 are derived from existing canonical producers. They are not supplied as additional hypotheses. The residual factor is included for \(r>0\); for \(r=0\), it is the zero-dimensional unit factor from the existing actual product-law and affinity producers. The theorem imposes no positive-remainder condition and includes all source-domain endpoints.
assumptions: \(d,n\in\mathbb N,\ 3\le n\le d,\ \kappa\ge4\); set \(k=\lfloor d/n\rfloor\) and \(r=d-kn=d\bmod n\). Both endpoint inequalities are inclusive.

For normalized full orthogonal Haar probability \(\mu_n\), let \(\nu_\pm=2\mu_n|_{\{\det O=\pm1\}}\). Define \(A_O=\frac{\kappa+1}{2}I-\frac{\kappa-1}{4}(O+O^\top)\), \(\mathcal D_\pm=(\boldsymbol O\mapsto\operatorname{diag}(A_{O_1},\ldots,A_{O_k},I_r))_\#\nu_\pm^{\otimes k}\), and the actual averaged targets \(\bar\pi_\pm=\int\mathcal N(0,A^{-1})\,d\mathcal D_\pm(A)\). Each product uses one common sign.

Total variation uses the source probability convention \(\delta=\sup_{B\text{ measurable}}|\bar\pi_+(B)-\bar\pi_-(B)|=\frac12\int|f-g|\,dx\). In Lean, each event mass is \(M_\pm.\mathrm{real}(B)=\operatorname{toReal}(M_\pm(B))\); the actual laws are proved to be probabilities internally, so all event masses are finite. Nonempty/bounded event-supremum and mass-one density obligations are discharged by the canonical normalized-density theorem.

The proof uses actual ambient RN densities \(f=d\bar\pi_+/dx\), \(g=d\bar\pi_-/dx\), and actual block affinity \(a=\int\sqrt{p_+p_-}\). Absolute continuity, L1, normalization, the exact tensorization \(\int\sqrt{fg}=a^k\), and Eq25 are derived from existing canonical producers. They are not supplied as additional hypotheses.

The residual factor is included for \(r>0\); for \(r=0\), it is the zero-dimensional unit factor from the existing actual product-law and affinity producers. The theorem imposes no positive-remainder condition and includes all source-domain endpoints.

obligations.label: Actual common-sign averaged Gaussian laws satisfy the exact final Ex72 exponential TV lower bound.

bindings.boundary: Selected final Ex72 inequality for the actual averaged Gaussian laws, plus a focused actual-TV>=1/2 consumer under the explicit parameter threshold k*exp(-10n/sqrt(kappa))/8>=log 2. No oracle/transcript, exact-matvec query lower bound, deterministic worst-case cap, sampling-TV-precision reduction, expected-cost adapter or fixed-spectrum hidden-eigenbasis lower bound is asserted here. Independent source verification, root/site integration, remote publication, postmerge purification/Exposition Seal and whole Goal completion are separate phases.
